purpose: Shared cross-domain contract for any durable generative beginning: constitutions, charters, treaties, covenants, religious formations, schools, companies, protocols, standards, scientific programmes, movements, lineages and project-native foundations.
applies_when: Use when a record needs to explain not merely origin but the stable reference/platform and reproduction mechanism by which later continuity, branching, amendment or refoundation becomes possible.
integration_rule: Domain records keep substantive identity. Foundation records are cross-domain generative-history records referencing those owners; they do not replace country, religion, company, school, law, technology or project records.
integrity_rules: Do not force one birthday when authorization, legal effect, operation and consolidation differ.
Ancient or emergent traditions may require ranges and contested/traditional dates.
A predecessor/root is not automatically the foundation.
A founding document is insufficient unless the reproduction/operation mechanism is stated.
Refoundation must state what changed and what continuity is claimed.
Superseded foundation states remain addressable in Archive.
Project-symbolic foundation claims retain their own evidence class.
Store current survival separately from historical origin.
Place Foundation stages rather than assigning one moral altitude to the whole Foundation.
Fear/love and angel/demon motifs may appear only as project-native motive lenses and cannot override evidence.
Reader surfaces lead with Door/date/place, House owner/circle, and current snapshot before technical Seed genealogy.
Physical map anchors and House/circle placement are separate coordinate systems.

reader_projection.rule: The Foundation Room is the main reader object. Seed/root/sprout remain technical genealogy beneath it.
